questions.question: What is overfitting in machine learning?
expected_evidence: learns the training data too closely
expected_answer_points: A model learns the training data too closely.
A model may learn noise and accidental patterns in the training data.

questions.question: Why can a model with too many parameters overfit?
expected_evidence: too few training examples relative to the complexity of the model
memorize training examples instead of learning general patterns
expected_answer_points: A model with too many parameters relative to the available training examples can overfit.
The model may memorize training examples instead of learning general patterns.

questions.question: How does training for too many epochs contribute to overfitting?
expected_evidence: performance on validation data becomes worse
expected_answer_points: Training performance may continue improving when training for too many epochs.
Validation performance may become worse when training for too many epochs.

questions.question: What are other factors that contribute to overfitting?
expected_answer_points: Data leakage can contribute to overfitting.
Noisy labels can contribute to overfitting.
Insufficient regularization can contribute to overfitting.
A poorly designed validation process can contribute to overfitting.

questions.question: What are the consequences of overfitting?
expected_answer_points: Overfitting reduces the model's ability to generalize.
An overfitted model can make inaccurate predictions on unseen data.
An overfitted model can still achieve high training accuracy.

questions.question: How can overfitting be reduced?
expected_answer_points: Regularization can discourage overly complex models and help reduce overfitting.
L1 regularization can help reduce overfitting.
L2 regularization can help reduce overfitting.
Dropout can help reduce overfitting.
Early stopping can help reduce overfitting.

questions.question: What is the difference between overfitting and underfitting?
expected_evidence: performs poorly on both training and unseen data
expected_answer_points: An overfitted model performs well on training data but poorly on unseen data.
An underfitted model performs poorly on both training data and unseen data.
Underfitting occurs when a model is too simple or insufficiently trained.

questions.question: What is the relationship between overfitting and underfitting?
expected_answer_points: Overfitting and underfitting are both problems in model learning.
Overfitting results in good performance on training data but poor performance on unseen data.
Underfitting results in poor performance on both training data and unseen data.
